prompts.question: Does the company appear in ACT Ai's procurement analytics as a bidder on Thai state contracts, and does its bidding show a flagged pattern such as single-bidder awards, an unusual bidding network, or a conflict of interest with a public official?
prompts.why_it_matters: It shows whether the company's public contract work is tied to suspicious bidding networks or officials.
prompts.how_to_query: Open ACT Ai's company search and enter the company name or its Thai registered name.
prompts.found_when: The company returns a profile with procurement awards, bidding partners or a flagging signal.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search on the full registered name returns no company record.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search only matches the exact Thai legal name, or the page loads without results or errors.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a corporate member in the AMCHAM Thailand member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Chamber membership signals vetted foreign-linked standing and a partner network worth checking.

source.name: American Chamber of Commerce in Thailand (AMCHAM Thailand)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the AMCHAM connect member search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears as an AMCHAM corporate member profile.
prompts.not_found_when: No member profile matches the company name in a clean search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search sits behind a member login, or the name returns many similar firms.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in ATTA's member directory of travel agents?
prompts.why_it_matters: ATTA lists bonded, association-vetted travel agents, so absence questions the company's tourism credentials.
prompts.how_to_query: Open ATTA's member-directories page and scan or search the list for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the ATTA member directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The member directory has no entry for the company under a clean search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory is long and paginated, or the firm uses a different Thai and English trade name.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member company in the British Chamber of Commerce Thailand directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: BCCT membership is a vetted signal of standing in Thailand's British and international business community.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the BCCT members corporate search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A BCCT corporate member profile opens for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The member search returns no company of that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member area requires a login, or the company is listed under a group or abbreviated name.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Bank of Thailand's directory of licensed financial institutions, non-bank lenders, money changers, foreign exchange operators or payment providers?
prompts.why_it_matters: Running a financial business without a BOT licence is illegal, so the listing settles whether the licence exists.

source.name: Bank of Thailand (BOT) - Financial Institutions & Non-Bank Directory

prompts.how_to_query: Open the BOT licence check search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company is listed with a BOT licence type and supervisory status.
prompts.not_found_when: The licence check returns no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup needs the exact Thai legal name and licence category, or the service is unavailable.

prompts.question: Does the company have a Creden Data profile showing its DBD registration, shareholders, directors and public procurement award history?
prompts.why_it_matters: Cross-shareholding and director links reveal undisclosed related parties and ownership risk.
prompts.how_to_query: Use Creden's company suggestion search and enter the registered company name.
prompts.found_when: A company profile opens with registration, ownership and award data.
prompts.not_found_when: The suggestion search returns no matching registered company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search needs the Thai registered name, or the detailed results sit behind a paid plan.

prompts.question: Does the company's project appear in ONEP's Smart EIA Plus registry with an approved or pending environmental impact assessment?
prompts.why_it_matters: Factories, property, energy and mining projects cannot legally proceed without the EIA clearance recorded here.

source.name: Office of Natural Resources and Environmental Policy and Planning (ONEP Smart EIA Plus)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the EIA registry by company name or by the project name.
prompts.found_when: A project record appears with an EIA, EHIA or IEE status for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The registry returns no project for the company under a clean search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Records are filed under project names rather than company names, or the site times out.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as an active VAT registrant (Por Por 20) in the Revenue Department's VAT registrants search?
prompts.why_it_matters: VAT status confirms the business is a live, tax-registered entity rather than a dormant shell.

source.name: Revenue Department - VAT Registrants Search (ภ.พ.20)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the VAT registrant search and enter the company name or its 13-digit tax ID.
prompts.found_when: The company appears with an active VAT certificate status, branch number and place of business.
prompts.not_found_when: The VAT search returns no registrant for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search requires the tax ID or a captcha, or the service is down.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in ETDA's registry of licensed digital platform providers, digital identity providers or electronic certification authorities?
prompts.why_it_matters: Digital platform and e-transaction duties depend on whether ETDA has licensed or registered the operator.
prompts.how_to_query: Open ETDA's published licence lists and scan them for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears on one of ETDA's published licence or registration lists.
prompts.not_found_when: None of ETDA's published lists contains the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lists are split across several pages and published only in Thai.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Franco-Thai Chamber of Commerce online business directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: FTCC listing shows the company is a recognised member of the French-Thai business community.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the FTCC online annuaire search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears as an entry in the FTCC online directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory search returns no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory lists member firms only, or the search matches French and Thai names inconsistently.

prompts.question: Is the company a listed member of an FTI industrial club, or registered in one of FTI's industry records such as GS1 barcodes or Made-in-Thailand certification?
prompts.why_it_matters: FTI records show whether the company is a recognised operator in the industrial sector it claims.

source.name: Federation of Thai Industries (FTI / ส.อ.ท.)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the FTI member search and enter the Thai company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in an FTI club member list or one of its registers.
prompts.not_found_when: The member search returns no club or register entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member search matches Thai names only, or lapsed memberships are not displayed.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the e-GP government procurement system as a contract winner, and is it on the published blacklist of disqualified or abandoned contractors?
prompts.why_it_matters: This shows the company's record of state contract awards and any ban from public work.

source.name: Electronic Government Procurement (e-GP) - Comptroller General's Department

prompts.how_to_query: Search e-GP by company name for award records, then check the blacklist page for the same name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in e-GP award records or on the blacklist.
prompts.not_found_when: Neither the award search nor the blacklist shows the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The award search needs a Thai name, or the blacklist page is unavailable.

prompts.question: Does the company hold a valid Halal certificate in CICOT's Halal registry, with current certificate and certified product ranges?
prompts.why_it_matters: An absent or expired Halal certificate makes a Halal claim on the company's products misleading.

source.name: The Central Islamic Council of Thailand (CICOT Halal)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the CICOT Halal database by company name or Halal certificate number.
prompts.found_when: A certificate record appears with the company's certified products and expiry date.
prompts.not_found_when: No Halal certificate is registered to the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Records are keyed to product or certificate numbers, or the search page fails to load.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member of the Housing Business Association in its developer and contractor member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: HBA membership indicates a residential developer vetted against the association's housing standards.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the HBA members contractor list and scan it for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the HBA member list.
prompts.not_found_when: The member list has no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The list loads dynamically and only partly, or the developer is a project-level subsidiary.

prompts.question: Does the company appear on JobTH with active job postings, and do the hiring locations match the address it gives elsewhere?
prompts.why_it_matters: Live postings evidence real operations, while mismatched locations point to a misdescribed or phantom employer.
prompts.how_to_query: Use JobTH's keyword company search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company has a JobTH employer profile or current job postings.
prompts.not_found_when: The keyword search returns no company profile or posting.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The employer posts under a trade name, or only closed listings remain visible.

prompts.question: Is the company reviewed on JobTopGun's YouSay workplace review tool, and do its employee ratings point to any management or culture problems?
prompts.why_it_matters: Anonymous employee reviews reveal management and culture issues that never appear in official filings.
prompts.how_to_query: Browse JobTopGun's company directory for the company name and open its review page.
prompts.found_when: A company page with employee reviews or ratings exists.
prompts.not_found_when: The company directory has no page for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory is browsable only letter by letter, or the employer registers under a different trade name.

prompts.question: Does the company operate a storefront on Lazada Thailand, and how do its seller ratings and customer complaint records look?
prompts.why_it_matters: Marketplace ratings and dispute complaints show how the company treats retail customers.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Lazada catalog for the company's brand or store name.
prompts.found_when: A LazMall or seller storefront appears with ratings or reviews.
prompts.not_found_when: The catalog search finds no storefront or products under the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search returns unrelated products, or the company does not sell on the marketplace.

prompts.question: Is the company registered as a licensed direct sales or direct marketing operator in the OCPB registry?
prompts.why_it_matters: Direct sales and MLM schemes need this licence, so its absence suggests unauthorised or pyramid selling.

source.name: Office of the Consumer Protection Board (OCPB / สคบ.)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the OCPB direct sales licence registry by company name.
prompts.found_when: A licence record appears with the company's operator status.
prompts.not_found_when: The registry lists no licensed operator under that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The registry needs the Thai legal name, or the service is under maintenance.

prompts.question: Does the company hold Thai FDA registrations, with valid licence numbers, for the food, supplement, drug, cosmetic or medical device products it sells?
prompts.why_it_matters: Selling regulated products without a valid FDA registration is illegal and licences can lapse unnoticed.

source.name: Thai Food and Drug Administration (Thai FDA / Oryor)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the Oryor product database by company or product name.
prompts.found_when: Registration records appear under the company with validity dates.
prompts.not_found_when: No registration record is found for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Records are keyed to product names or licence numbers, or the search returns nothing for a common name.

prompts.question: Does the company, or any of its directors, appear in SEC Thailand's licence register, enforcement actions or investor caution lists?
prompts.why_it_matters: SEC sanctions and blacklists point to securities law breaches and barred directors.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the SEC licence check and enforcement pages, searching by company and by director name.
prompts.found_when: A licence record, sanction order or caution notice names the company or one of its directors.
prompts.not_found_when: No licence, sanction or warning entry matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The check only covers capital-market entities, or a common name matches several companies.

prompts.question: Is the company a listed issuer on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, and do its audited statements and 56-1 One Report match what it claims publicly?
prompts.why_it_matters: Listed issuers must disclose audited financials and risks, which tests the company's own claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the SET listed company list and symbol lookup for the company name.
prompts.found_when: A listed company profile with financial statements and filings exists.
prompts.not_found_when: The company is not among SET listed issuers.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Only listed companies appear, or the name matches a subsidiary listed under a different symbol.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in Techsauce's startup directory or coverage, with a funding round, accelerator programme or founder profile?
prompts.why_it_matters: Independent startup coverage corroborates or contradicts funding and traction claims made by the company.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the Techsauce startup directory and the site itself by company name.
prompts.found_when: A startup profile or article names the company with funding, programme or founder details.
prompts.not_found_when: Neither the startup directory nor the site returns the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory covers startups only, or the company trades under a different name.

prompts.question: Is the audit firm or CPA signing the company's financial statements listed as licensed and active in the TFAC directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Statements signed by an unlicensed or suspended auditor cannot be relied on.

source.name: Federation of Accounting Professions (TFAC / สภาวิชาชีพบัญชี)

prompts.how_to_query: Search the TFAC corporate auditor database by the audit firm name or CPA name.
prompts.found_when: The firm or CPA appears with a valid licence status.
prompts.not_found_when: No licensed firm or CPA matches the name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The auditor name must first be read from the DBD filing, or Thai names match loosely.

prompts.question: Is the company a listed member of the Thai Frozen Foods Association as a seafood or frozen food processor and exporter?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership signals a vetted export processor meeting the association's sanitary standards.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the association's member directory and scan it for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the association's member directory with a processor profile.
prompts.not_found_when: The member directory has no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory lists members only, or the firm appears under a different export trade name.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Thai-Chinese Chamber of Commerce's company directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: Listing indicates Thai-Chinese ownership or joint-venture links and the business network that comes with them.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Thai-CC company search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A company record appears in the chamber directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The directory search returns no company of that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory holds member firms only, or the search needs the exact Thai or Chinese name.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member in the Thai Condominium Association's directory or referenced in its market intelligence coverage?
prompts.why_it_matters: Membership shows the developer is recognised in Thailand's condominium sector.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the association's site search and enter the developer or company name.
prompts.found_when: A member entry or article mentioning the company appears.
prompts.not_found_when: The site search returns nothing for the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site mixes news and member pages, so a hit may not prove membership.

prompts.question: Is the company's hotel or resort listed as a member in the Thai Hotels Association directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: THA listing confirms a registered accommodation operator inside the association's network.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the THA member directory for the relevant region and scan it for the hotel name.
prompts.found_when: The hotel or resort appears in a regional THA member list.
prompts.not_found_when: None of the regional member lists contains the hotel.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lists are long and split by region, or the property is a branch under another name.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member rice exporter or miller in the Thai Rice Exporters Association registry?
prompts.why_it_matters: Only licensed exporters appear, so listing settles whether the company can legally ship rice.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the association's member list page and scan it for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the member list of exporters and millers.
prompts.not_found_when: The member list has no entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The static list is outdated, or the firm trades under a different registered name.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Thai Subcontracting Promotion Association's member directory as an industrial subcontractor?
prompts.why_it_matters: Listing evidences real manufacturing capability at the tier the company claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the Thai Subcon member search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A member profile appears showing the company's manufacturing capabilities.
prompts.not_found_when: The member search returns no company of that name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory covers registered subcontractors only, or the profile page is unreadable.

prompts.question: Does the company have a verified exporter or supplier profile on Thaitrade.com, the government B2B marketplace?
prompts.why_it_matters: Verified profiles confirm the company is a registered Thai exporter with real product catalogues.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Thaitrade.com suppliers by company name.
prompts.found_when: A supplier profile with verification badge and product catalogue appears.
prompts.not_found_when: The supplier search returns no profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search matches product categories better than names, or the profile is incomplete.

prompts.question: Does the company appear on Wongnai with a business listing, and what do its customer ratings and reviews say about it?
prompts.why_it_matters: Local reviews and customer photos show whether the outlet really operates and how it is regarded.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Wongnai businesses by company or outlet name.
prompts.found_when: A business page with ratings, reviews or photos appears.
prompts.not_found_when: No business listing matches the company name.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The listing may sit under a branch or trade name, or the company is not consumer facing.

prompts.question: Does the company have a WorkVenture employer profile with insider employee reviews, culture assessments and leadership scores?
prompts.why_it_matters: Insider reviews expose culture, pay and management problems that official records hide.
prompts.how_to_query: Search WorkVenture's company search by company name.
prompts.found_when: An employer profile with reviews, ratings or leadership scores exists.
prompts.not_found_when: The company has no employer profile on WorkVenture.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Only companies that register as employers appear, or the name matches a subsidiary.

prompts.question: Does the company have a YellowPages Thailand listing, and do its phone number, address and branch details match its official registration?
prompts.why_it_matters: A mismatched or missing directory entry signals unreliable contact data or a phantom office.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the YellowPages search and enter the company name.
prompts.found_when: A listing appears with contact details that can be compared to the registration.
prompts.not_found_when: No listing matches the company name in a clean search.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Listings are keyed to trade names and paid placements, so absence is not proof.
